items.title: Strategy, Coinbase Stocks Rose After Trump Met Crypto Execs
items.summary: Shares of Bitcoin-related companies rose on Wednesday as cryptocurrency industry leaders met with President Donald Trump at the White House.  Shares of  Strategy  among the world’s largest corporate holders of Bitcoin, closed up 12.7% at $104.25, notching their highest close since June 22 and their largest percentage increase since Feb. 6, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Coinbase  Global stock closed up 9.6% at $160.20, its highest close since July 30, and its largest percentage increase since July 21.
